prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Yttrium (Y) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a night-train sleeper compartment with a narrow berth, a fold-down table and a small window
Weather / season: a rainy day — rain falls outside and streaks any window; surfaces are wet where she is outdoors.
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Outfit: a sequined bodycon mini dress — in clean neutrals such as white, ivory, oatmeal or soft grey; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; right now — a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing at a work surface, upper body leaning slightly forward over it, hips back and weight on both feet.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she eats from a bowl of hot food set on the table in front of her — her own right hand lifts a bite with chopsticks or a spoon, her own left hand steadies the bowl.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: brows level, eyes bright and steady, closed-lip smile with a firm mouth.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — yttrium: a soft silvery metal, the first rare earth ever separated, drawn in 1794 from a heavy black stone found in a Swedish quarry that gave its name to four elements, yttrium the eldest; decades later its oxide was split again and two younger sisters were found hiding inside it; with aluminium it forms yttrium aluminium garnet, the clear crystal at the heart of powerful lasers that cut steel and of the fine green beams of eye surgery; with cerium it is the yellow phosphor that turns a blue LED warm white, with europium the red glow of screens; in 1987 it joined barium and copper in a ceramic that loses all electrical resistance at the temperature of liquid nitrogen, and it keeps zirconia from cracking — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

generation.note: Original PNG retained; repository contains WebP only.

observations: 1024x1536 verified; adult single focal figure; painted anime rendering. Visible limbs are naturally connected; cropped parts cannot be counted.
Leaning toward a bowl in train compartment, one hand with spoon and other at bowl. Both arms connected; planned wet clothing is visible.

acceptance: User authorized QA and normal main integration, 2026-11-16; no exposure-based regeneration.
